definition: A retrieval-augmented generation variant that builds and queries a knowledge graph extracted from source documents, rather than retrieving flat text chunks.
details: GraphRAG aims to improve on standard RAG for tasks requiring understanding of relationships and structure across a corpus (such as summarizing themes across many documents), by first organizing extracted entities and relations into a graph.

citation.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
